prompt:
Edit this planetary albedo texture to materially improve its resolution and geological detail for a close-up real-time 3D planet.
OUTPUT RESOLUTION: 3840 x 1920 pixels, landscape 2:1. Use the highest native output resolution available. This needs real added fine detail.
Keep the same global arrangement of the broad dark basalt basins, warm gray cratered highlands and rust-ochre branching canyon. Reconstruct extremely crisp, finely fractured crater rims, many small secondary craters, delicate ejecta rays, stratified escarpments, scree and dusty regolith. Avoid soft smears and large featureless regions. Maintain realistic orbital-scale geology.
Keep the map rectangular, flat equirectangular, pole-stretched, longitude-wrapping, edge to edge. Uniform diffuse albedo lighting: no directional shadows, sunlight, atmospheric glow or sphere rendering. No text, labels, borders or background. Preserve its subdued stone-gray/brown palette, don't brighten or add new large landforms.
note: The image tool returned 1774x887. The final 4K material combines this reconstructed source with new fine crater and fracture detail baked in Blender; the source is not claimed to be native 4K.
